quarantine.detail: Shared root cause with plan4-successor-wave-consumption, plan4-successor-wave-objective-map and four-plan-closeout-blocker-map, tracked as ATM-BUG-2026-09-22-002: commit 4d3bce0e4 refreshed docs/reports/plan-3x-4x-backlog-disposition-census.json on 2026-09-06 and the reports whose digests bind them to it were never recompiled. The recorded assertions in this test still hold against the live data; what fails is the validator's source digest check. No generator for these maps exists in the repository, so refreshing the digests by hand would assert a recompilation that did not happen. Needs an owner decision on who regenerates them, or a generator, before the test can leave quarantine.

Guards a 600-line budget on the CLI owner shard, which holds 184 mappings in 1256 lines. Sharding it along the families the model already uses brings the main shard to 579 lines, but 26 other tests read owner-shard-cli.json directly and expect their mapping there, and 9 of them failed when the split was tried (batch-final-600, broker-command-facade-final-600, close-orchestrator-final-600, closure-packet-schema-extraction, git-governance-command-extraction, next-command-facade-final-600, next-playbook-projection-contracts, taskflow-final-600, tasks-legacy-impl-extraction). Splitting the shard needs those tests to read the merged projection first; the attempt was reverted.

Needs the planning repository: it compiles runbook completion evidence from a sibling 3KLife checkout that a CI clone does not have.

Needs the planning repository: the reviewer fails with "missing runbook: ../3KLife/docs/ai_atomic_framework/governance-optimization/plan-3x-4x-false-green-correction-complete-closeout-runbook-2026-08-09.md". A CI clone has no sibling 3KLife checkout.

Same root cause as taskflow-open-orchestration: host policy allocates the next task id by scanning the profile repository’s docs/tasks, not the --cwd fixture, so the expected TASK-GOVERNED-0002 depends on whether a 0001 card is left in this repository. Whether a profile may redirect reads and writes outside --cwd is an owner decision.

Root-caused 2026-09-20: taskflow open resolves its output root from the profile path (resolveTaskflowOpenOutputRoot returns the profile repo git root), not from --cwd. The test passes a profile that lives in this repository, so the generated card lands in the framework repo docs/tasks instead of the requested cwd, and the run dirties the worktree. Whether a profile may redirect writes outside --cwd is an owner decision; do not change the resolver to make the test pass.

serial.detail: Drives the shared package-dist / root-drop release build under the repository root. These builds write the same packages/cli/dist and release/** trees, so running two of them at once makes one overwrite the other's half-written output and the build exits non-zero. They must run one at a time.
